children.title: Trump declares a national emergency at the southern border
children.description_medium: On January 20, 2025, President Donald Trump declared a national emergency at the U.S. southern border. The declaration directed military and executive support for border-control measures. It was one of two separate emergency declarations issued that day, not an omnibus order spanning immigration, energy and economic policy.
children.description_long: The White House published a southern-border emergency declaration dated January 20, 2025. The action concerns the U.S. southern border and directs military and executive support for border-control measures. Its subject and scope are distinct from the separate national energy emergency declaration issued that same day. The supplied record supports describing the border declaration as a discrete presidential action; it does not support treating it as one omnibus order combining immigration, energy and economic policy. The date used here is the date of the presidential action stated in the source, rather than a later publication date. This description does not add claims about implementation, legal effects, later litigation or specific agency actions because those details are not contained in the supplied evidence. Naming the geographic focus and directed support captures the documented event while keeping it within the source’s scope. The same-day energy action belongs in its own record.
children.date_uncertainty: Date is the declaration date shown in the White House action.

children.title: Trump declares a national energy emergency
children.description_medium: On January 20, 2025, President Donald Trump separately declared a national energy emergency. The declaration directed agencies to use emergency and other authorities to facilitate domestic energy production and infrastructure. This was a distinct presidential action from the same-day southern-border declaration, with a separate energy focus.
children.description_long: The White House published a national energy emergency declaration dated January 20, 2025. President Donald Trump directed agencies to use emergency and other authorities to facilitate domestic energy production and infrastructure. This was a separate presidential action from the southern-border emergency declaration also issued that day. Keeping the two actions in separate records avoids implying that one omnibus emergency order spanned immigration, energy and economic policy. The supplied evidence supports the date, declared subject and general direction to agencies. It does not provide a basis here for adding specific projects, production outcomes, economic effects or subsequent implementation details. The description therefore stays with what the presidential action is identified as doing and preserves the distinction between two declarations issued on the same date. It does not characterize the declaration’s legal consequences or assert that any particular agency action followed. The cited action is the source for its date and stated direction.
children.date_uncertainty: Date is the declaration date shown in the White House action.

rationale: Two distinct January 20 presidential declarations have direct White House sources and are drafted as separate events.
